quote.text: L’attention est la forme la plus rare et la plus pure de la générosité.
quote.english: Attention is the rarest and purest form of generosity.

poem.text:
馬をさへ
ながむる雪の
朝哉
poem.roman: uma wo sae / nagamuru yuki no / ashita kana
poem.english:
even the horse
holds my eye — snow
on the morning road
poem.note: Written on the road in his first travel journal, the one he set out on expecting to die of exposure. He noticed a horse instead.
poem.translator: translated for this page, not a published version

song.title: Gymnopédie No. 1
song.note: Three pieces written when he was twenty-two and playing piano in a Montmartre cabaret. Nobody could place them; he called himself a phonometrician rather than a musician.
